name: Naqi Water Company
summary: Naqi Water Company engages in the production and bottling of filtered pure water in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company is involved in the wholesale of bottled water, soft drinks, and juices; and retail sale of beverages in specialized stores. In addition, it is involved in the land transportation of goods; and rearing and producing broiler breeder hens, operating hatcheries, and producing eggs. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Unaizah, Saudi Arabia.
